question: After the config-reload task-title leak is fixed, should OpenClaw accept this bounded restart-specific `gateway_restart_audit` table with `audit_json` and `preflight_json`, or require a narrower audit model first?
rationale: The PR creates durable local audit storage with source/session/preflight metadata, so the permanent payload shape and retention policy are a product/security boundary rather than a pure implementation detail.

options.title: Accept narrowed restart audit
options.body: Land the restart-only audit table after all durable producers are metadata-only and rows remain bounded.

options.title: Require column-only metadata
options.body: Remove or narrow the generic JSON blobs before accepting the new durable storage surface.

options.title: Defer to broader audit design
options.body: Pause this PR and fold restart records into a broader operator audit-ledger design instead.

recommendation.title: Accept narrowed restart audit
recommendation.body: Land the restart-only audit table after all durable producers are metadata-only and rows remain bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: The related audit-ledger issue and current labels make the remaining choice about durable audit metadata scope a maintainer product/security decision.
